page: Microsoft Azure D32nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

The server is equipped with 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It is designated as a network-optimized instance, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs, making it reliant entirely on its Intel CPU resources for computational tasks.

With a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware profile represents a standard general-purpose configuration with enhanced local storage density. This resource balance makes the instance appropriate for workloads requiring a mix of compute, memory, and fast local storage, such as database hosting, network-heavy applications, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
